messages:
hana: quick flag  nightly-recon found ~45 invoices where tax line in NetSuite is higher than Stripe. Pattern: tax rate changed during checkout and a subsequent older `invoice.updated` replay removed the updated taxRates array, leaving legacy tax applied. example invoice inv_Tx9.
jorge_fin: rough $ impact? need to know whether to approve automated corrections.
hana: preliminary total ~$2,900. Stripe payloads show two tax snapshots: first `tax_rates: [old]` then `tax_rates: [new]` when customer used updated address. Our consumer applied the newer tax when `invoice.finalized`, but later retried `invoice.updated` with older snapshot overwrote lines.
sam: sounds like same out-of-order replay issue but specifically for tax snapshots. we dedupe by event.id only and write full invoice object on update. short-term fix: persist `last_event_ts` per invoice and ignore older events (or merge tax arrays using `max(created)` semantics).
devon_ops: Finance needs CSV with invoice_id, customer, delta_tax, suggested action. Also avoid touching month-end posting window. backfill should include note referencing Stripe event ids.
billing-bot: daily-recon job #daily-recon found 45 tax mismatches. Job link: /jobs/4455. total discrepancy: $2,903.14. CSV: /secure-drive/finance/tax_mismatch_2307654321.csv
jorge_fin: finance approves automated corrections for totals under $5k. Include audit trail and NetSuite memo text.
hana: plan:
1) patch consumer to track `last_event_created` and reject older events for same invoice (PR + canary).
2) run backfill script to create tax adjustment credit memos for affected invoices.
3) add metric `webhook.tax.snapshot_replay` and alert if >1/min or $1k in 1h.
sam: opening PR: https://internal/git/stripe-consumer/pull/678 - changes: store per-invoice last_event_created in Redis, ignore events with created <= last_event_created, emit metric `webhook.tax.snapshot_ignored`.
hana: running dry-run for backfill now: `python tools/tax_backfill.py --csv /secure-drive/finance/tax_mismatch_2307654321.csv --dry-run --out /tmp/tax_dryrun_2307654321.json`
billing-bot: dry-run complete: 45 adjustments, total $2,903.14. output: /tmp/tax_dryrun_2307654321.json
devon_ops: please run backfill before daily close at 05:00 UTC. we'll schedule to avoid posting window.
hana: starting backfill with 5/s rate. uploading NetSuite memo ids to secure drive when done.
billing-bot: backfill started job_id=77890 ETA ~18m
sam: canary on staging looks good; metric `webhook.tax.snapshot_ignored` emitted for some test replays. will roll to 10% prod after backfill validation.
hana: backfill finished. created 45 tax adjustment memos. CSV: /secure-drive/finance/tax_adjustments_2307654321.csv. re-ran daily-recon: no remaining mismatches for those invoices.
jorge_fin: thanks. filing FIN-548 RCA: cause = replay of older invoice.updated with legacy tax snapshot; fix = enforce event ordering per invoice, add backfill, metric + alert. Finance to review postmortem.
devon_ops: adding alert to paging rules and a dashboard tile for `webhook.tax.snapshot_ignored`. closing loop once 48h stable.
hana: will attach PR and backfill job ids to FIN-548. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
